title: Google Open Buildings v3 polygons - S2 level 4 tile 3bf
notes: Official GCS shard gs://open-buildings-data/v3/polygons_s2_level_4_gzip/3bf_buildings.csv.gz; SHA-256 1b453ac5e7369247dd30122890264d5a99baebd52e71249307b2d806ab5b37b6. The CSV publishes no upstream row ID, so source_record_key is explicitly a Helios SHA-256 surrogate over tile, Plus Code and source WKT. CRS is EPSG:4326.

title: Open Buildings Temporal v1 building height and presence - 2023
license_name: CC BY 4.0 and ODbL 1.0 terms described by the provider
notes: Height and uncalibrated building-presence bands were sampled at each v3 polygon centroid from the official COGs named in candidate records. COG pixels are delivered at 0.5 m while the provider documents an effective resolution of 4 m. Missing or zero height remains null.

title: OpenStreetMap mapped roads in the Kharghar AOI
notes: Mapped highways only; completeness varies. EPSG:4326 exchange layer. Person 2 must retain the matched OSM feature ID when calculating proximity.

title: OpenStreetMap mapped power infrastructure in the Kharghar AOI
notes: Mapped substations, transformers, lines, minor lines, plants and cables. This supports a proximity proxy only and does not represent hosting capacity or interconnection approval.

title: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 terrain - N19 E073
notes: Window-clipped without modifying elevation values. Terrain context only; it is not a building or roof elevation measurement. Exchange raster CRS remains EPSG:4326.
